posts.title: LLM post-processing
posts.description: Claude's response is never the final answer. Between the model's last token and the HTML that lands in S3, Now I Get It! runs a pipeline that filters, augments, and instruments the page. Here's what's in it and why each piece earned its spot.

posts.title: Curated design styles, no deploy required
posts.description: A dropdown now lets customers pick a visual style for their generated page -- Academic Editorial, Vintage Travel Poster, Brutalist, and more. The interesting part was making the styles editable by an operator without touching code.

posts.title: Inline editing now available!
posts.description: Sometimes, AI-generated web pages contain small errors. These are now fixable by using the built-in HTML and KaTeX editor.
